picks.file: Panorama of Klaipėda by Juozas Narūnavičius, 1674.jpg
picks.what: Painted panorama of Memel with the castle
picks.why: color panorama: castle at left, walled town and fortifications at right; red border trimmed

picks.what: View over the rooftops and church spires, postcard
picks.why: general view with three church spires; white card border and “Memel” caption trimmed

gaps: P0, P1, P3: no candidates. P4: only #2, dated just “before World War II, likely before 1923”, too uncertain. P6: nothing showing the old town or skyline.
notes: P5 alternates: #4 (1938 view from the Lietūkis warehouse, firm date, one spire) and #3 (Dangė harbor, 1928, lively but a street-level port scene). #2 is a fine pre-war view (Reformed church and St. Jacob’s) if a firm date can be found. P6 candidates are the bare castle-site mounds (#6), aerials of the university (#7, #8) and a river bend outside town (#9).
